DetectIPCObject.title: IPC Image Object Detection
DetectIPCObject.description:
## Feature Description  
The IPC image object detection capability can detect target objects in the input image, such as people, vehicles, pets, and more.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- This capability is available for a complete free trial on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=objectdet&children=DetectIPCObject) to experience this feature interactively or purchase it online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, API usage, or other issues related to Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios

- **Intelligent Home Monitoring**: Generates high-definition video when people or pets move at home, enabling detection alerts. It also allows you to monitor your pet's activities while you are away.  
- **Intelligent Store Monitoring**: Provides security for outlets, especially during nighttime, by promptly notifying you when someone enters the store.  
- **Intelligent Factory Monitoring**: Safety is critical in industrial zones. This feature effectively monitors employee presence and detects unauthorized intrusions.

## Key Advantages

- **Wide Range of Scenarios**: Supports object detection across diverse everyday environments, including indoor and outdoor settings, homes, stores, shopping malls, daytime, and nighttime.  
- **Broad Detection Range**: Capable of detecting objects of various sizes—suitable for both large objects and small objects captured by distant cameras.  
- **High Detection Efficiency**: Handles high concurrency with short processing time.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure that you have activated the [Object Detection service](https://vision.aliyun.com/objectdet). If not, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_objectdet_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, you must grant the RAM user the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can debug this capability using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/objectdet/2019-12-30/DetectIPCObject?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=old&params=%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Fobjectdet%2FDetectIPCObject%2FDetectIPCObject1.jpg%22%7D&tab=DEMO), where you can view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "objectdet" (object detection).  
   - Modify the sample code provided in the documentation as needed and invoke the API.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages for this capability, see [IPC Image Object Detection Sample Code](~~604396~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods for this capability include the following:  
   - [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input Restrictions

- **Image format**: JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 2 MB.  
- **Image resolution**: Greater than 20×20 pixels and less than 1024×1024 pixels. Higher resolution does not necessarily mean higher accuracy. Recommended value: the longer edge should be 640 pixels.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of IPC image object detection, see [Billing Introduction](~~202484~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid API. For a free debugging experience, go to the [Experience Center](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=objectdet&children=DetectIPCObject).

DetectKitchenAnimals.description:
## Service Notice  
Due to product adjustments, the DetectKitchenAnimals service is no longer available to new users starting today. Existing users who have previously activated this service may continue using it. However, the service will be delisted on April 20, 2026, after which it will no longer be available to either new or existing users. Please plan alternative solutions as soon as possible. If you have questions about using the DetectKitchenAnimals API, search for DingTalk group 23109592 to join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API support group and contact us.

## Feature Description  
The DetectKitchenAnimals capability leverages visual AI algorithms, Internet of Things (IoT), and big data analytics technologies to detect whether animals such as cats or mice are present in a scene, enabling real-time alerts.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or other issues related to Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API capabilities, please join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API support DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
Back kitchens or warehouses: In areas such as kitchen preparation rooms or food storage warehouses, this service detects the presence of animals like cats or mice in real time and triggers immediate alerts to notify staff for prompt action and prevention.

## Key Advantages  

- **High detection accuracy**: Trained extensively on diverse scene samples under varying environments, lighting conditions, angles, and target states, the algorithm model achieves high recognition precision.  
- **Strong adaptability**: The algorithm model adapts well to different spatial layouts and is directly applicable to various restaurant back kitchens and front-of-house dining areas.  
- **Proprietary algorithm**: By integrating risk detection across multiple endpoints and scenarios, the system forms a closed-loop process covering detection, alerting, rectification, and optimization. Combined with data analytics and rule extraction, it continuously enhances model performance through feedback from production use.

## Input Restrictions  

- **Image format**: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 4 MB; aspect ratio of 16:9 is recommended.  
- **Image resolution**: Greater than 1080×720 pixels.  
- **Consistent dimensions**: Consecutive input images must maintain consistent dimensions.  
- **Camera perspective**: Images must be captured from a camera viewpoint.  
- **URL encoding**: Image URLs must not contain Chinese characters.  
- **Recommended resolutions** for images and detection targets are shown in the table below.  
![](https://viapi-oss.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/doc/objectdet/cat_mouse.png)

- Temporary files uploaded during testing or debugging are valid for 1 hour and will be automatically deleted by the system after 24 hours.

> The debugging API below is a paid interface. To experience free debugging, go to the [Experience Center](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=objectdet&children=DetectKitchenAnimals).

schema.description: The URL of the image. We recommend using an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. If your file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~).
schema.title: A short description of struct

schema.description: Multiple regions. The format is `[RoadRegion_1, RoadRegion_2, ..., RoadRegion_N]`.

RoadRegion.description: The X and Y coordinates of the four vertices of an arbitrary quadrilateral, formatted as `[x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4]`.

Point.description: The coordinates of a vertex of the quadrilateral.

X.description: The X value of the coordinate point.

Y.description: The Y value of the coordinate point.

schema.description: Vehicle features corresponding to vehicle detection boxes from the previous frame that intersect with specified areas.

Features.description: The feature is a Base64-encoded string.

items.description: A Base64-encoded string. For Base64 encoding operations on files, see [File Base64 Processing](~~468191~~).

schema.description: Schema of Response

Data.description: The content of the returned result data.

Elements.description: A collection of vehicle detection boxes.

Boxes.description: The coordinates of the detection box, in the format `[left, top, right, bottom]`.

Left.description: The x-axis coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangular area.

Top.description: The y-axis coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangular area.

Right.description: The x-coordinate of the bottom-right corner of the rectangular area.

Bottom.description: The y-coordinate of the bottom-right corner of the rectangular area.

Score.description: The confidence level of the detection box, ranging from `[0,1]`.

TypeName.description: The object corresponding to the detection box. The value is only `vehicle`.

Id.description: The ID of the detection box.

RegionIntersectFeatures.description: The vehicle features corresponding to the vehicle detection bounding boxes that intersect with each specified area.

Features.description: The feature is a Base64-encoded string. For information about how to perform Base64 encoding on files, see [File Base64 Processing](~~468191~~).

items.description: This Base64-encoded string is used to determine whether vehicles detected in two frames are the same vehicle. For information about how to perform Base64 encoding on files, see [File Base64 Processing](~~468191~~).

RegionIntersectMatched.description: Indicates which feature in RegionIntersectFeatures of the current frame matches a feature in PreRegionIntersectFeatures.

items.description:
When two vehicles across two frames are matched, it indicates that the vehicle experienced congestion or remained stationary during the time interval between the two frames.

> **-1** indicates no matched feature. If a match exists, the corresponding detection box ID is displayed. For example, if the vehicle detection box IDs are `[1,2,3]` and RegionIntersectMatched displays `[-1,-1,-1]`, none of the three regions have matches. If RegionIntersectMatched displays `[-1,2,3]`, region 1 has no match, while regions 2 and 3 are matched.

RegionIntersects.description:
The vehicle features corresponding to the vehicle detection bounding boxes that intersect with each specified area.  

For example, if the return result is `[{"Ids":[1,3]}, {"Ids":[2,4]}]`, `{"Ids":[1,3]}` represents the IDs of vehicle detection bounding boxes that intersect with area 1, and `{"Ids":[2,4]}` represents the IDs of vehicle detection bounding boxes that intersect with area 2. If a vehicle appears within a specified area, it indicates that the vehicle is occupying the lane.  

Except for the detection bounding boxes whose IDs are included in **RegionIntersects**, all other detection bounding boxes are outside the specified areas.

Ids.description: The multiple IDs of vehicle detection bounding boxes that intersect with each specified area.

items.description:
Multiple IDs of vehicle detection boxes that intersect with each specified area.

For example, {"Ids":[1,3]} represents the IDs of vehicle detection boxes that intersect with the corresponding area.

DetectVehicleICongestion.title: Vehicle Congestion Detection
DetectVehicleICongestion.description:
## Feature Description  
The vehicle congestion detection feature determines whether congestion has occurred based on vehicles in an image.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this feature is available on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=objectdet&children=DetectVehicleICongestion) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, API usage, or other issues related to Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API's visual AI capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios

- **Parking Lot Congestion Detection**: Capture two images from a parking lot camera at a set interval, detect vehicles and their relative positions, and determine whether congestion has occurred.  
- **Road Congestion Detection**: Capture sequential images from road monitoring cameras at a set interval, detect vehicles and their relative positions, and determine whether congestion has occurred.

## Key Advantages  
**Low Data Volume Requirement**: No large video data is required. Congestion can be determined by analyzing just two images.

## Integration Guide

## Service Notice  
Due to product adjustments, the vehicle illegal parking detection service is no longer available for new users starting from today. Existing users who have previously activated this service can continue to use it. However, the service will be delisted on April 20, 2026, and will no longer support invocation by either new or existing users. Please plan alternative solutions as soon as possible. If you have any questions about using the vehicle illegal parking detection API, please search for DingTalk group (23109592) and join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform consultation group to contact us.

## Feature Description  
The vehicle illegal parking detection capability determines whether vehicles are parked within specified target areas in an image.

> - You can obtain live assistance through [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, interface usage, or other issues related to visual AI capabilities of the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, please join our consultation DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  

- **Fire lane occupancy**: Detect whether vehicles are present in fire lanes to determine if they are being blocked.  
- **Entrance/exit illegal parking**: Detect whether vehicles are illegally parked in designated areas at entrances/exits of parking lots, shopping malls, residential communities, or industrial parks.

## Key Advantages  

- **Easy deployment**: Only requires an input image to perform detection and judgment.  
- **Multi-angle support**: Supports detecting illegal parking from various angles.

## Input Restrictions  

- **Image formats**: JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP.  
- **Image size**: We recommend keeping it under 3 MB.  
- **Image resolution**: Must be greater than 20×20 pixels; we recommend keeping it below 3000×3000 pixels.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.

DetectVideoIPCObject.title: IPC Video Object Detection
DetectVideoIPCObject.description:
## Feature Description  
The IPC video object detection capability can detect target objects in the input video, such as people, vehicles, pets, and more.

> - You can get live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- This capability is available for a full free trial on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=objectdet&children=DetectVideoIPCObject) to experience it interactively or purchase it online.  
- For questions regarding API integration, usage, or consultation about Visual Intelligence API capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  

- **Intelligent Home Monitoring**: Generates high-precision video clips when people or pets move at home, enabling detection alerts. It also allows you to monitor your pet's activities while you're away.  
- **Intelligent Store Monitoring**: Enhances store security, especially during nighttime, by promptly notifying you when someone enters the store.  
- **Intelligent Factory Monitoring**: Safety is critical in industrial zones. This feature effectively monitors staff presence and detects unauthorized intrusions.

## Key Advantages  

- **Wide Applicability**: Supports object detection across diverse everyday scenarios, including indoor and outdoor environments, homes, stores, shopping malls, daytime, and nighttime.  
- **Broad Detection Range**: Capable of detecting objects of various sizes—from large nearby objects to small distant ones captured by cameras.  
- **High Efficiency**: Handles high concurrency with short processing time.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure you have activated the [Object Detection service](https://vision.aliyun.com/objectdet). If not, activate it immediately via [Activation Link](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_objectdet_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online Debugging (Optional)**: You can debug this capability using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/objectdet/2019-12-30/DetectVideoIPCObject?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=old&params=%7B%22VideoURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Fobjectdet%2FDetectVideoIPCObject%2FDetectVideoIPCObject1.mp4%22%7D&tab=DEMO). View complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  

5. **Development Integration Steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "objectdet" (object detection).  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in common programming languages to query asynchronous task results, see [Sample Code for Querying Asynchronous Task Results](~~607974~~).  

7. **Direct Client Invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods for this capability include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input Restrictions  

- **Video format**: H.264 or H.265.  
- **Video resolution**: Greater than 20 × 20 pixels and less than 4096 × 4096 pixels.  
- **Video frame rate**: Must be 35 frames per second or lower.  
- **Video size**: Must not exceed 10 MB.  
- **Video duration**: Must not exceed 10 seconds.  
- **URL**: Must not contain Chinese characters.

## Billing Information  
For details on the metering method and pricing of IPC video object detection, see [Billing Introduction](~~202484~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid API. For a free debugging experience, go to the [Experience Center](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=objectdet&children=DetectVideoIPCObject).

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two steps to invoke:  
1. Call the `DetectVideoIPCObject` API to submit a job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. This returns the task execution status and result. If the task is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again.

## Service Notice  
Due to product adjustments, new users can no longer activate or invoke the workwear detection service effective immediately. Existing users who previously activated this service may continue to use it. However, the service will be delisted on April 20, 2026, after which neither new nor existing users will be able to invoke it. Please identify an alternative solution as soon as possible. If you have any questions about using the workwear detection API, search for DingTalk group 23109592 to join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API support group and contact us.

## Feature Description  
The workwear detection capability leverages visual AI algorithms, Internet of Things (IoT), and big data analytics technologies to detect whether personnel within specified scenarios are properly wearing items such as hats, masks, and work uniforms, and provides real-time alerts for non-compliant behavior.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API capabilities, please join our support DingTalk group (23109592) by searching for the group number and contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
Workwear compliance detection: Detects whether staff in restaurants (kitchens and front-of-house areas), service halls, construction sites, factories, oilfields, and similar environments are wearing required attire (e.g., clothing, hats, masks) in compliance with regulations. Real-time alerts are triggered for non-compliant behavior, prompting corrective actions.

## Key Advantages  

- **High Detection Accuracy**: Trained extensively on diverse scene samples under varying environments, lighting conditions, angles, and target states, resulting in high-precision algorithm models.  
- **Strong Adaptability**: The algorithm model adapts well to different spatial layouts and is directly applicable to various restaurant kitchens and dining areas.  
- **Proprietary Algorithm**: Integrates risk detection across multiple endpoints and scenarios into a closed-loop process—detection, alerting, rectification, and optimization—enhanced by data analytics and rule extraction to continuously improve model performance.

## Input Restrictions  

- **Image Formats**: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP.  
- **Image Size**: No larger than 2 MB; aspect ratio recommended as 16:9.  
- **Image Resolution**: Greater than 1080×720 pixels.  
- **URLs**: Must not contain Chinese characters.

For error codes related to querying asynchronous job results, see [Common Error Codes](~~146760~~).

## SDK Reference  
Alibaba Cloud visual AI capabilities support invocation via software development kits (SDKs). For details, see [SDK Overview](~~145033~~) to download and install the SDK.

## Security Statement  
- Ensure that the source of uploaded images or files complies with applicable laws and regulations.  
- Temporary files uploaded during testing and debugging expire after 1 hour and are automatically deleted by the system after 24 hours.
